title: The Watch tab no longer shows the wrong build
author: Blitzwing, Tank Designer-Developer
body: The Watch tab could show a build that wasn't in the link. A bad seed typed in Customize left the previous match and its tank cards on screen, and a match that ended while a change was pending named the changed build. Watch now always describes the match that is running, and a new browser check covers both cases.
next: run the browser check in CI.
